description: Executes a list of bundles (a bundle is a collection of transactions), without creating transactions on the blockchain.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: An array with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: transaction
sub_parameters.description: The transaction call object which contains the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: from
sub_parameters.description: The address from which the transaction is sent

sub_parameters.name: to
sub_parameters.description: The address to which the transaction is addressed

sub_parameters.name: gas
sub_parameters.description: The integer of gas provided for the transaction execution

sub_parameters.name: gasPrice
sub_parameters.description: The integer of gasPrice used for each paid gas encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description: The integer of value sent with this transaction encoded as hexadecimal

sub_parameters.name: data
sub_parameters.description: The hash of the method signature and encoded parameters. For more information, see the Contract ABI description in the Solidity documentation

sub_parameters.name: blockOverride
sub_parameters.description: (Optional) The overrides of the execution context block header

sub_parameters.name: blockNumber
sub_parameters.description: The block number. Defaults to the block number of the first simulated block

sub_parameters.name: blockHash
sub_parameters.description: A dictionary that maps blockNumber to a user-defined hash. It could be queried from the solidity opcode BLOCKHASH

sub_parameters.name: coinbase
sub_parameters.description: The address of miner. Defaults to the original miner of the first simulated block.

sub_parameters.name: timestamp
sub_parameters.description: The timestamp of the current block. Defaults to the timestamp of the first simulated block. Each following block increments its timestamp by 1.

sub_parameters.name: difficulty
sub_parameters.description: The difficulty of the current block. Defaults to the difficulty of the first simulated block.

sub_parameters.name: gasLimit
sub_parameters.description: The gas limit of the current block. Defaults to the difficulty of the first simulated block.

sub_parameters.name: baseFee
sub_parameters.description: The base fee of the current block. Defaults to the base fee of the first simulated block.

sub_parameters.name: blockNumber or Tag
sub_parameters.description: The Tag 'latest', 'earliest', 'pending', 'safe' or 'finalized', or a hexadecimal block number

sub_parameters.name: transactionIndex
sub_parameters.description: The transaction index of the simulated transactions. Default value of the transaction index is -1, which would place the simulated transactions after the entire block.

parameters.name: STATE_OVERRIDE
parameters.description: (Optional) The State Override Set option allows you to change the state of a contract before executing the call, which means you can modify the values of variables stored in the contract, such as balances and approvals for that call without actually modifying the contract. Each address maps to an object containing:

sub_parameters.name: balance
sub_parameters.description: The fake balance to set for the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: nonce
sub_parameters.description: The fake nonce to set for the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: code
sub_parameters.description: The fake EVM bytecode to inject into the account before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: state
sub_parameters.description: The fake key-value mapping to override all slots in the account storage before executing the call

sub_parameters.name: stateDiff
sub_parameters.description: The fake key-value mapping to override individual slots in the account storage before executing the call

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: The upper limit running time for the simulations in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000 milliseconds.

array.description: An array with the following fields:

array.value.description: The value if the transaction was successful

array.error.description: (Optional) The error if the transaction failed
